personSeals.description: SF Guard seals (SPEC-PSS-v1 §10.8): the presence signature of a person record whose own format is an immutable, exact-key summary, kept beside it and found again by the record's digest.

pendingDecision.description: A workflow decision waiting for a person; the phase it follows is approved and current.

completion.description: The final evaluation the transition that ended the Story passed. Cleared when rework reopens it.

applicability.description: Why a responsibility the workflow leaves out does not apply to this Story, decided by a person in the omission's approval group.

scopeDispositions.description: A person's disposition of each accepted-scope inventory item: the clauses that carry it, or a scope decision with its reason.

scopeRevisions.description: Append-only, hash-chained revisions of the Story's accepted clause set: what changed, and the generation each later step had reached, so evidence is stale only for the clauses that changed. A Story with spec.observedDependencies on records scope-revision/v2, which adds the stale set with each clause's reason and the edges used; v1 records are never rewritten and the chain runs through both [CIC:REQ-002].

stale.description: The clauses this revision makes stale, each with its reason: added, revised, depends on the stale or removed clauses in via, or unrecorded when the revision recorded no changes [CIC:REQ-002, REQ-006].

edges.description: The dependency edges the stale reasons used.

riskDecisions.description: Append-only governed risk acceptances on obligations and their revocations: category, permitted transitions, expiry, the observation accepted, reason and authority.

testCommandDecisions.description: Append-only Story-only test commands: a request for one exact structured test command for a step, and a step approver's acceptance or revocation of it. An accepted command runs at every publication and submission of the step like a configured one; its tests must pass.

repin.description: A request that the command's changed pin replace its recorded one [TCE:REQ-012]: the exact pin, by digest, a person accepts.

diff.description: Each change before and after, as a person reads it: a script's text, or a configuration file's changed lines. `known: false` means the pinned text is no longer in the Story's history.

dropped.description: Whether the change drops tests, in words.

pathNarrowing.description: Each path the change names that the base commit did not, and the base commit's test files it leaves out.

removed.description: The request is that a pinned suite the step no longer runs stay removed; `sha256` and `pinned` name that pin.

testCommandPins.description: Test command pins [TCE:REQ-010]: what a gate first ran for a command (argv, working directory, affected roots, adapter and the digests of the scripts and runner configuration it resolves through), recorded when the gate commits. A later run that differs is refused until a person accepts a re-pin; the replacing pin names the one it replaces and the request that admitted it. Only `baseline` is ever set after a pin is recorded.

definitionVersion.description: The definition rules the pin was recorded under; absent is version 1, which reads only the working directory's script and configuration. Version 2 follows what the command resolves through; version 3 pins only the configuration of the runners it reaches.

testScopeChanges.description: Append-only changes of which tests the Story's gates run (story test-policy scope) [TCE:REQ-090]. The last entry is the scope in force; each records who changed it and, when it moved to fewer tests, why. Recorded runs are not touched.

testNarrowings.description: Append-only decisions by a step's approvers that a narrowed run of one of its test commands (filters, focused tests, skipped tests, fewer tests than the pin's baseline) is enough, and their revocations [TCE:REQ-023]. A decision is bound to the command's pin and the narrowing it saw, and covers later runs whose narrowing is the same or smaller, until it expires or is revoked.

testRunRisks.description: Append-only decisions by a step's approvers that one of its test commands cannot run in this environment, and their revocations. A decision lets through only a run of the same command whose classified cause is the environment class it accepted, until it expires or is revoked; a decision without a class (recorded before causes were classified) covers only environment-classified runs in which no test executed.

causeClass.description: The environment cause class the decision accepted (src/test-run-cause.mjs), or several joined by + in sorted order when the failed tests of the accepted run failed from more than one.

boundBy.description: The decision names the command by its ID, argv digest and cause class because no run of it was recorded in the approver's checkout; it has no observation, and every run it lets through is checked for that cause.

settledDecisions.description: Append-only decisions the agent or SFlow settled because one clear answer had evidence SFlow can name, so no person was asked [owner, 2026-11-13]: which Story a session opens, the author's own correction of its unreviewed draft, the Node a module's tests run on, a test command the repository alone declares, a changed file a plan row already covers. Each names its answer and evidence. A person's undo ({ undoes }) makes it their question again; an undo is a person's record SF Guard signs.

findingRisks.description: Append-only acceptances by a person of one lint, static-analysis or security finding a code step keeps, or of a scanner that cannot run under enforce, and their revocations [CQF:REQ-047]. Each binds the finding's fingerprint, rule, tool and tool version until it expires (at most 90 days) or is revoked. A security finding is accepted by the workflow's security reviewers when it names them, otherwise by the step's approvers.

evidenceReuses.description: Append-only decisions by the approvers of a step that a passed, structured test attempt an earlier step of the Story recorded stands for this step, and their revocations. A decision binds the attempt ID, the digest of its record, its source commit and the application source tree digest it ran on; it applies only while the current tree matches that digest. The reusing step is never recorded as having run the tests.

visualProfileDecisions.description: Append-only decisions by the approvers of a visual verification step that one of its verification profiles (screen sizes) does not apply to this Story, and their revocations. Coverage lists such a profile as not applicable, never as passed; at least one profile must still be evidenced, and a revocation makes the profile required again.

testPolicy.description: The digest of the Story's sealed test policy and test capability record, written once at creation.

witnessRecords.description: Append-only inspection and visual witnesses of a criterion's contract slot: the exact file bytes inspected, a fixed checklist, the reviewer and their authority.

planAmendments.description: Append-only plan amendments recorded by someone in the group that approves the plan: a changed path accounted for as part of one row's delivery or listed as a supporting change of a closed class, an evidence-contract correction, or a plan row correction.

oneOf.description: A plan row correction (UIF-M1): rows, tests and paths of an approved plan corrected in place by its approvers, bound to the owner generation, map digest and each replaced row's digest, and applied by every plan reader in recorded order.

intentAmendment.description: The intent amendment that carried these rows, signed in its plan approver's decision on it; in force once it is approved.

upstreamIssues.description: Append-only defects a later step recorded against an earlier, approved step (UIF-M2). Raising needs no authority and never refuses the current step; the issue is never edited.

supersedes.description: Optional, written only when set: the open issue this one replaces (raised against the wrong step). The replaced issue is never edited; its approvers decide it as dismiss.

upstreamIssueDecisions.description: Append-only decisions on upstream issues by the earlier step's approvers; an issue's latest decision applies and an expired accepted risk reopens it.

forwardAmendments.description: Append-only proposals of corrected bytes for an earlier approved document step (UIF-M3), saved in the Story before its approvers decide.

forwardAmendmentDecisions.description: Append-only decisions on forward amendments by the amended step's approvers; an approval lists the later steps to revalidate with the generation each was approved at.

amendmentRevalidations.description: Append-only revalidations of approved later steps after a forward amendment: unchanged (bound to the amended producer generation and bytes and the step's exact input record) or return. A v2 entry (amendment-revalidation family) keeps the person's name beside the actor key; a v1 entry has no schemaVersion and no name.

completenessReviews.description: A person's review of the accepted-scope inventory's interpretation, bound to its exact digest and answering every article of the requirements-quality checklist. It never claims the scope is correct.

retainable.description: The phase was approved when rework reset it; its approval may be retained by rule E1 when nothing it decided over changed.

scopePin.description: SPEC-CIC switch 2 [CIC:REQ-008, REQ-009]: the step an approved intent amendment reopened in place, pinned to the amended scope. Its generation publishes only a draft whose code generation and composed prompt started under this scope revision or a later one (and, for a document step an agent may have written, that was composed again under it; its text may be the kept draft's unchanged); its earlier prompt pair and open code generation, closed as superseded, are kept under setAside and its draft read only under draft.

storyTestCommands.description: The step's Story-only test commands a step approver accepted, each bound to its request in testCommandDecisions; derived from those decisions.

dependencyRecords.description: SPEC-CIC switch 1: each published generation's dependency record (context/dependencies/<step>-gen<N>.json), by its path and digest [CIC:REQ-001, REQ-002].

personPresence.description: SF Guard (SPEC-PSS-v1): the approver's presence signature over this record, or the per-person exception it went ahead under unsigned. A record that needs one counts only when it verifies against the approver's pinned key.
